Description: Dual-lobe anisotropic velvet/fuzz shading with customizable edge rim glow, Ashikhmin-Charlie forward/backward scattering lobes, and chromatic pile shift.

Inputs.Name: BaseColor
Inputs.Description: Core dye color of the fabric weave (sRGB converted).

Inputs.Name: RimColor
Inputs.Description: Sheen rim tint at grazing viewing angles.

Inputs.Name: Normal
Inputs.Description: Normalized surface normal vector in world space.

Inputs.Name: TangentFlowMap
Inputs.Description: Directional tangent flow vector for fabric pile combing.

Inputs.Name: RoughnessCore
Inputs.Description: Micro-roughness of the core fabric body.

Inputs.Name: RoughnessRim
Inputs.Description: Micro-roughness of the grazing sheen highlight.

Inputs.Name: RimExponent
Inputs.Description: Exponential falloff curve for rim lighting.

Inputs.Name: RimIntensity
Inputs.Description: Amplitude multiplier for edge fuzz glow.

Inputs.Name: AnisotropyStrength
Inputs.Description: Anisotropic pile stretch factor along tangent direction.

Inputs.Name: ChromaticShiftAmount
Inputs.Description: Weight of the core-to-rim chromatic shift.

Outputs.Name: CompositeBaseColor
Outputs.Description: BaseColor with chromatic pile shift applied.

Outputs.Name: SheenColor
Outputs.Description: Sheen color for Substrate Sheen / Cloth BSDF.

Outputs.Name: SheenRoughness
Outputs.Description: Micro-fuzz roughness input for Substrate Sheen.

Outputs.Name: RimMask
Outputs.Description: Isolated scalar rim glow mask for secondary styling.

Outputs.Name: SubstrateClothWeight
Outputs.Description: Blend weight for activating Substrate Cloth Shading Model.
